name: Open Food Facts
author: Wasi Master
description: Scan a barcode, or type one or a name, to see a product's Nutri-Score, NOVA group, Green-Score, ingredients, allergens, vegan, vegetarian and palm oil status, and labels such as halal, organic and fair trade. Looks in Open Beauty Facts, Open Pet Food Facts and Open Products Facts too. Signed in, add missing products, ingredients read with the camera, and photos.

settings.label: Look beyond food
settings.summary: When a barcode is not in Open Food Facts, try Open Beauty Facts, Open Pet Food Facts and Open Products Facts
